title: normalize only lower-cases the name
prompt: names.py is meant to turn raw user input into a display name: trimmed, with runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, and title-cased. Right now it just lower-cases everything, so '  ada lovelace ' comes out as '  ada lovelace '. Hyphenated names should title-case each part, so 'jean-luc picard' becomes 'Jean-Luc Picard'.
